# Screenberry Knowledge Base

Text-only product knowledge. Public default: 3.4; 3.5 is in development. Imported records are in_review. Use explicit version/profile selection. Search knowledge/ only; illustrations/ contains optional User Guide editorial briefs, not factual evidence. No binary media is bundled.
